name: numkong
description: Portable mixed-precision math, linear-algebra, & retrieval library with 2000+ SIMD kernels for x86, Arm, RISC-V, LoongArch, Power, & WebAssembly
author: Ash Vardanian

scripts.install: node -e "require('@numkong/' + process.platform + '-' + process.arch)" || node-gyp-build-test || npm run prebuild
scripts.prebuild: npm run build-native && node javascript/stage-prebuild.js build_node
scripts.prebuild-arm64: cmake-js compile --out build_node_arm64 --arch arm64 --CDNUMKONG_BUILD_NODE=ON --CDCMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=11.0 --target numkong_node && node javascript/stage-prebuild.js build_node_arm64 arm64
scripts.prebuild-x64: cmake-js compile --out build_node_x64 --arch x64 --CDNUMKONG_BUILD_NODE=ON --CDCMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=11.0 --target numkong_node && node javascript/stage-prebuild.js build_node_x64 x64
scripts.build-js: rm -fr javascript/dist/* && tsc -p javascript/tsconfig-esm.json && tsc -p javascript/tsconfig-cjs.json && cp javascript/dist-package-esm.json javascript/dist/esm/package.json && cp javascript/dist-package-cjs.json javascript/dist/cjs/package.json
scripts.test:wasm:browser: npm run build-browser && npx playwright test --config test/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:wasm:all: npm run test:wasm:emscripten && npm run test:wasm:emscripten64 && npm run test:wasm:wasi && npm run test:wasm:browser
scripts.bench:all: npm run bench:native && npm run bench:emscripten && npm run bench:browser
